summary: Shaded kerb beside a park, with parked cars and no homes within 30 m.
reasons: Park on this side of the road

best_section.where: East kerb of Underhill Avenue beside the memorial park, north of the main-road junction

drivers.seclusion: Park and playground on the section's side; nearest dwellings 31 m or more away, a BP service station 24 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street about 12 m wide with parked cars along it; room to stop clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Short side street off a busy main road; low local traffic, junction noise at the south end.
drivers.convention: Cars parked along both kerbs in Esri and QLD, so a van will blend in.

flags: Main road traffic noise near the south end
Shared with park visitors by day
sun_shade: Large trees over the kerb give shade, mostly from the east and south.
